result.text: {"pairs": [{"question": "What does the E-6292 error code mean on my Fenwick cooker hood?", "answer": "The E-6292 code means your Fenwick cooker hood has detected an electrical insulation fault in its fan motor."}, {"question": "Can I throw my broken hood in the trash?", "answer": "No, do not put the Fenwick cooker hood in your general rubbish bin."}, {"question": "How should I handle my Fenwick cooker hood if I decide to recycle it?", "answer": "If you choose recycling for your Fenwick cooker hood, ask a qualified electrician to disconnect any fixed wiring and make the supply safe before removal; do not cut cables or dismantle the motor yourself."}, {"question": "Where should I take the unit for recycling?", "answer": "Take the old Fenwick cooker hood to a household waste recycling centre that accepts electrical appliances, or ask your replacement appliance retailer about collection, making sure to check acceptance and booking requirements before travelling."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "Why is my Corra induction hob displaying E-3946?", "answer": "E-3946 means the Corra induction hob’s lid sensor has detected that the protective lid is not fully closed."}, {"question": "What should I do if the lid on my hob won't shut?", "answer": "Switch off the hob and let the cooking surface cool completely before checking it. Remove all cookware, then wipe the lid’s rim and the surrounding edge with a soft, damp cloth. Gently lower the lid without forcing it."}, {"question": "How long should I keep the power off if the lid is fixed?", "answer": "If the lid closes properly, switch the hob off at the wall for one minute, then restore power."}, {"question": "Am I allowed to fix the hinges on my appliance myself?", "answer": "Do not adjust the hinges yourself; if the lid remains crooked or stuck, contact Halvard Home support."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "What should I do if my Vale fridge freezer door does not shut properly?", "answer": "If your Vale fridge freezer door will not close fully, check for anything blocking it before trying again. Do not force the door shut."}, {"question": "How can I clean the seal on my appliance?", "answer": "Wipe the rubber door seal and the surface it touches with a soft cloth and warm water, then dry both."}, {"question": "Is it okay to use a tool to remove ice from the freezer?", "answer": "Look for ice build-up stopping the freezer door from closing. Do not chip ice away with a sharp tool."}, {"question": "Who do I contact if the seal on my fridge is split?", "answer": "If the door still hangs unevenly or the seal is split, contact Halvard Home support. Keep the door closed as much as possible while arranging help."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "Does the Brio kettle have a delay-start feature?", "answer": "The Halvard Home Brio kettle does not have a timer or delay-start setting."}, {"question": "How do I start boiling water?", "answer": "You must switch the Halvard Home Brio kettle on manually each time you want to boil water by pressing the power switch after filling it between the minimum and maximum marks and placing it on its base."}, {"question": "Can I use a smart plug to set my kettle to turn on in the morning?", "answer": "Do not use a plug-in timer or smart plug with the Brio kettle to create a delayed start, as it could be switched on unexpectedly or without enough water."}, {"question": "Does the kettle turn itself off?", "answer": "Yes, the Halvard Home Brio kettle switches off automatically once the water boils; this is not a timer function."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "What should I do before I start a firmware update on my Keel washing machine?", "answer": "Before starting a firmware update on your Keel washing machine, finish any wash programme, empty the drum and leave the machine switched on."}, {"question": "How do I update the software on my device?", "answer": "To update the firmware, make sure your washing machine is connected to your home Wi-Fi. Open the Halvard Home app, select your Keel washing machine, then choose Settings > Firmware update. If an update is available, tap Install and follow the instructions."}, {"question": "Are there things I should avoid doing while the update is in progress?", "answer": "Do not switch off the machine, unplug it or restart your router while the update is running. You cannot start a wash during installation."}, {"question": "What should I do if the installation process fails?", "answer": "If installation fails, check your Wi-Fi connection and try again. Contact Halvard Home support if it still fails."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "What should I look for before installing my Tessa dishwasher?", "answer": "Before installing your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher, remove all packaging and check for transport damage. Do not connect the appliance if it is damaged."}, {"question": "Are extension leads okay to use with this appliance?", "answer": "No, connect the Tessa dishwasher to an earthed socket and do not use an extension lead."}, {"question": "What steps should I take regarding the water and electricity before starting the installation?", "answer": "Switch off the electricity and turn off the water supply before connecting anything."}, {"question": "What do I need to do after installing the unit but before I start washing dishes?", "answer": "Turn the water supply back on and check the connections for leaks. Before loading dishes, run one empty wash cycle, following the installation guide’s first-use instructions."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "Does my Corra induction hob require internal descaling?", "answer": "No, your Corra induction hob does not need internal descaling."}, {"question": "What should I do if I see white marks on the glass surface?", "answer": "For stubborn white marks on the Corra induction hob, use a cleaner labelled as suitable for induction hob glass, following its instructions. Apply it to a cloth rather than pouring it onto the hob, wipe away any residue with a clean, damp cloth, and dry with a soft towel."}, {"question": "Can I use a metal scourer to clean the hob?", "answer": "No, do not use metal scourers on your Corra induction hob."}, {"question": "How should I prep the surface before I start cleaning?", "answer": "Switch the Corra induction hob off and let the surface cool completely before cleaning, then wipe away loose dirt with a soft cloth dampened with warm water and a little washing-up liquid."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "How long am I supposed to hold onto the Ashby tumble dryer packaging?", "answer": "Keep the original packaging of the Ashby tumble dryer for 51 days in case it needs to be returned."}, {"question": "What happens if my return is dirty?", "answer": "A returned Ashby tumble dryer that needs cleaning is charged £43.00, provided the cleaning is needed because of the condition in which you return the appliance and where charging is lawful."}, {"question": "How long does it take for you to inspect my return?", "answer": "A returned Ashby tumble dryer is inspected within 26 days of arrival."}, {"question": "Should I try to fix the appliance before I send it back because it's broken?", "answer": "You do not need to repair a faulty appliance before returning it, and you should not dismantle it to investigate the problem."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "What is the rule regarding the space around my Tessa dishwasher?", "answer": "You must leave at least 4 centimetres of space around the Tessa dishwasher and ensure that ventilation openings are kept clear of stored belongings, cloths, and packaging."}, {"question": "How often should I clean the air vents on my dishwasher?", "answer": "You should clean the air vents of the Tessa dishwasher every 98 days."}, {"question": "Can I use an extension lead for my appliance?", "answer": "No, you must not use an extension lead or an adaptor for the Tessa dishwasher; it must be connected to a suitable earthed electrical supply."}, {"question": "How long should I wait before cleaning my dishwasher?", "answer": "You must let the Tessa dishwasher cool for 7 minutes before cleaning it."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "What is the mandatory cooling time before I clean my Keel washing machine?", "answer": "You must let the Keel washing machine cool for 113 minutes before cleaning it."}, {"question": "How often should I clean the air vents?", "answer": "The air vents of the Keel washing machine should be cleaned every 9 days."}, {"question": "Is it okay to use an extension lead to plug in my new appliance?", "answer": "No, you must connect the Keel washing machine to a suitable earthed socket and do not use an extension lead or adaptor."}, {"question": "What is the minimum amount of space I need to leave around the machine?", "answer": "You must leave at least 25 centimetres of space around the Keel washing machine."}]}

{"pairs": [{"question": "How long should I wait before cleaning my Fenwick cooker hood?", "answer": "You should let the Fenwick cooker hood cool for 25 minutes before cleaning it."}, {"question": "How often does my appliance need a safety check?", "answer": "Have the Fenwick cooker hood safety-checked every 13 months."}, {"question": "I'm worried about my cooker hood's extraction, what should I do?", "answer": "If extraction seems weak, stop cooking if fumes are building up and arrange for the cause to be checked."}, {"question": "Can I let my kids help me clean the hood?", "answer": "Do not allow children to play with the hood or clean it unsupervised."}]}

We will explain the inspection arrangements and any applicable charge before you agree to a visit."}, {"question": "Am I covered if my appliance stops working due to a power surge?", "answer": "No, the Halvard Home warranty does not cover damage caused by power surges where those conditions caused the damage."}, {"question": "How quickly must I report cosmetic damage to my new unit?", "answer": "Cosmetic damage to a Halvard Home appliance must be reported within 7 days of delivery. {"pairs": [{"question": "How long does the Tessa dishwasher warranty last?", "answer": "The Tessa dishwasher is covered for 18 months from the date of delivery for faults caused by defects in materials or manufacture."}, {"question": "If I get a part replaced, how long is that new part covered for?", "answer": "Replacement parts fitted to the Tessa dishwasher are covered for a further 165 days, starting from the date the part is fitted as part of a repair authorised by Halvard Home."}, {"question": "How long do I get free labour for repairs?", "answer": "Labour for repairs on the Tessa dishwasher is free for the first 26 months, running from the delivery date for work authorised by Halvard Home."}, {"question": "I sold my dishwasher, how long does the new owner have to transfer the warranty?", "answer": "If the Tessa dishwasher is sold on, the new owner must transfer the warranty within 65 days of the date of sale."}]}
